mapper.select: SELECT * FROM zhw_user WHERE phone = #{phone} LIMIT 1

SELECT u.*, COALESCE((SELECT SUM(score) FROM zhw_user_score WHERE user_id = u.user_id), 0) AS score, (SELECT COUNT(1) FROM zhw_story WHERE user_id = u.user_id AND del_flag = '0' AND status = '0') AS story_count, (SELECT COUNT(1) FROM zhw_branch WHERE user_id = u.user_id AND del_flag = '0') AS branch_count, (SELECT COUNT(1) FROM zhw_comment WHERE user_id = u.user_id AND del_flag = '0') AS comment_count, COALESCE((SELECT SUM(b.like_count) FROM zhw_branch b WHERE b.user_id = u.user_id AND b.del_flag = '0'), 0) AS like_count FROM zhw_user u WHERE u.user_id = #{userId}
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO zhw_user (user_name, nick_name, avatar, remark, phone, gender, password, status, create_time) VALUES (#{userName}, #{nickName}, #{avatar}, #{remark}, #{phone}, #{gender}, #{password}, '0', NOW())
mapper.update: UPDATE zhw_user SET status = #{status}, update_time = NOW() WHERE user_id = #{userId}
UPDATE zhw_user SET password = #{password}, update_time = NOW() WHERE user_id = #{userId}
UPDATE zhw_user SET login_time = NOW(), login_ip = #{loginIp} WHERE user_id = #{userId}
